RETURN TO THE QUESTION

The name does not disappear.
Its surroundings become visible.

When a single voice emerges from music, the others do not fall silent. In the same way, selecting a hierarchy here is an act of attention: the surrounding field remains. The table gives the name a place; the image allows us to stay with the relation a little longer.

About this visual reading

This is an experimental visual edition of selected structures from the FMC overview, not a replacement for its complete page. Names and group membership follow FMC00.273. The 7-member field follows FMC00.661. The metaphors follow FMC00.668 and FMC00.403. Original charts remain available unchanged. Newly generated paintings are symbolic companions; their colours are not attributed to Steiner.

The activity lens follows FMC’s GA136 section. The human/cosmic lens follows its discussion of GA026, Leading Thoughts 69–71. These references were checked on FMC; the primary lecture editions were not independently collated. The diagrams show relationships within the source’s spiritual framework, not established physical measurements.

No personal archive material is included. Long quoted introductions and draft notes from the original page are not reproduced. Source page checked 16–17 October 2026.
